comments.text: I was a supervisor years ago over irregs, box retape, address corrections, hazmat clean-up and disposal, and safety and compliance and I was the first one in UPS history to be a supervisor and a union member. Those who know what a Pittsburgh report is will find that I also did the job of 3 people while I worked there while working 2 other jobs earlier in the day before coming to work there. I was paid 1200 per week 5 days in that week and 5 hours per night with benefits of full time. I had 2 supervisors above me in that hub. Did I mention that this all happened in Texas heat whereas I started loading trucks first one trailer by myself and the 2 simultaneously by myself then loading those 2 trucks and doing irregs by myself the doing all of that and miss sorts while loading 2 trucks and doing irregs. So yes it is a hard job that requires a lot and most of the ones I worked with were either ex military or women and neither seemed to mind the labor involved. I'm not defending the corporation. "My opinion is and long has been that the mayor and aldermen of a city corporation, or the president and directors of a bank, or the president and directors of a railroad companv and of other similar corporations, are the true parties that sue and are sued as trustees and representatives of the constantly changing stockholders.... A corporation, therefore, being not a natural person, but a mere creature of the mind, invisible and intangible, cannot be a citizen of a state, or of the United States, and cannot fall within the terms or the power of the above mentioned article, and can therefore neither plead nor be impleaded in the courts of the United States.'
